title: npm audit reports 4 HIGH vulns — Next.js 14.2.35 in advisory range
evidence: advisory ranges include: next 9.3.4-canary.0 - 16.3.0-canary.5 (broad range — may over-report)
disprove_gate: Run `npm audit --json | jq .vulnerabilities.next.severity` and cross-reference GHSA IDs against Next.js 14.2.35 changelog
blocked_question: Are the Next.js CVEs (GHSA-9g9p-9gw9-jx7f etc.) actually patched in 14.2.35, or does the audit range over-report?

title: New prisma-compat-check.mjs guardrail prevents Prisma v4 API regression
disprove_gate: Add `Prisma.validator<T>()` to any .ts file and run the guardrail — confirm it exits 1

title: Prisma v4→v5 migration gap: single missing API call silenced 4 tests and had no guardrail
disprove_gate: Check git log for the prisma 4→5 upgrade commit and audit all files changed at that time for similar deprecated calls
blocked_question: Were there other Prisma v4 APIs (Prisma.raw, new Decimal, findFirst without null-assert) used at the time of the Prisma v5 upgrade that still need review?
